escena: SCENE (open workspace at night, Santiago): THE SHADOWS ARE THE SUBJECT. On a bare concrete wall, FOUR separate hard-edged shadows of Nexa are thrown by four separate low lights, each falling across a different workstation, each caught in a different working posture on its own desk with its own glowing cool blue screen: one typing, one reviewing a page, one on a call, one pointing at a screen. Nexa herself stands in the near foreground at the LEFT third, seen in clean PROFILE facing right towards the wall — her face, profile and the front of her navy piqué polo visible, NOT her back — one hand resting on the nearest desk, watching the four shadows work. She is one person; the wall is doing four jobs with her. The four lights are rigged LOW, at desk height, so the shadows are short and wide and reach only to about 55% of the frame height; the wall ABOVE them is bare, unlit and in deep even shadow. Her head stays BELOW 55% of the frame height. Very high contrast. The orange sculpture sits on the nearest desk, clearly visible. 35mm lens at f/4, focus on the shadows, her profile slightly soft. CRITICAL FRAMING: the ENTIRE UPPER HALF of the frame — everything above 50% of the frame height — is one single dark, evenly toned surface with NOTHING in it: no object, no screen, no lamp, no window, no light beam, no bright spot. All action, all light and every bright patch stay strictly BELOW the middle of the frame. The whole frame is COOL and contemporary: daylight-neutral white balance, blue-leaning shadows, nothing warm, amber, golden or tungsten anywhere, no retro glow — the ONLY warm colour in the entire picture is the small orange sculpture itself. The sculpture's ring-and-nodes symbol belongs ONLY to the sculpture: it never appears on her clothing. Everything except the sculpture and the polo is completely unbranded and no text is readable.

lecho.objeto: the near edge of the first desk crossing the very bottom against the lens, outside every beam

texto.muro: the bare concrete wall filling the whole upper half above the shadows, unlit and evenly toned in deep shadow, its texture visible
